parsed.explanation: Combined national-state regime imposes universal traveller-facing exposure: binary national documents/facilities policy, entry discrepancy fraud risk, and state ban on gender-congruent public facilities enforced by criminal trespass, with one arrest and men's-ward custody. If detained for other reasons, documented custody harms include hormone removal, forced labour, beatings and sexual abuse. No execution, no likely imprisonment for identity alone, private facilities outside state ban, and courts, injunctions, national hate-crime/employment protections and local ordinances provide partial recourse. Minors face school-facility, sports and care bans. This sits above routine-detention anchors with almost no remedy, below anchors where remedies reliably reverse initial denial.

entry_documents.exposure: National binary sex definition; X/new mismatched passports stopped Feb 2025; entry cable directs refusal where documents cast reasonable doubt and consideration of permanent fraud ineligibility for wilful misrepresentation. State licences with non-birth-sex markers treated as fraud.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid to expiration; passport policy challenged by civil-liberties suit; several orders enjoined. Foreign visitor's home passport is not issued under this regime.
entry_documents.interaction: Document discrepancy at entry can escalate to refusal, investigation and potential detention, reaching facilities and custody exposures.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: One trespass arrest March 2025, handcuffed and held 24 hours in men's ward; national prison model from 2026 includes hair cutting, hormone removal and psychiatric substitution; immigration custody reports forced labour, beatings, solitary and severe sexual abuse of trans men.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Tresspass case dismissed June 2025 on standing; courts have enjoined some national orders; no documented execution or likely long imprisonment for presentation itself.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Bathroom refusal to depart triggers trespass, then birth-sex custody placement; immigration detention compounds harm if entry offence alleged.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: 2023 state statute bars gender-congruent restrooms/changing facilities in government-owned/leased buildings including schools, universities, airports, parks, courts, prisons; authority may order departure, non-departure is criminal trespass up to 60 days. National order bars government-funded congruent facilities.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Private businesses outside state statute scope; statutory exemptions exist; offence requires wilful entry plus refusal to depart when asked, not entry alone.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: On-site authority's order is the operative trigger; national and state bans overlap in public buildings, airports and schools.

care_services.exposure: State bans gender-affirming care for minors, adds adult waiting, physician-only and insurance barriers; national orders target minor care and funding. Adult care disrupted by physician-only rule.
care_services.protection: June 2024 national judge permanently blocked provisions banning minor and adult care, but later appellate status is not documented; 55% population in localities with broader protections.
care_services.interaction: Travelling minor or adult needing continuity of hormones may face denial/delay, especially outside emergency care; records subpoena risk documented for minors.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: National executive orders, counterterrorism strategy prioritising 'radically pro-transgender' groups, DOJ 'radical gender ideology' framing, trans-athlete entry ban, 2025 poll 66% support birth-sex documents. State travel advisory 2023.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: National hate-crime statute covers gender identity, 2020 employment ruling, nationwide same-sex marriage recognition, courts actively hear challenges.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Official threat framing raises probability of document/facility enforcement and reduces police-protection assumptions despite formal protections.

minors_guardians.exposure: School facilities and female sports exclusions by birth sex, minor care ban, national order to investigate/prosecute teachers facilitating social transition, custody-modification laws linked to care, hospital records subpoenas for under-19s.
minors_guardians.protection: Some care provisions blocked in June 2024; local conversion-therapy bans and sanctuary measures exist in places but some struck down.
minors_guardians.interaction: Parent travelling with minor encounters school/airport facilities, potential care denial, and if care sought, legal exposure for providers and custody implications for residents rather than short visitors.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: State law severity analysis reports 3.7 trans women murdered per 100k/year without general homicide baseline for comparison; state hate-crime law does not cover gender identity and no state employment/housing/public-accommodations statute.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime coverage, human-relations commission enforcing national employment/housing/public-accommodations holding since 2021, counties/cities covering 55% of population prohibit gender-identity discrimination.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Police were alerted in advance for the documented bathroom arrest; street-level protection depends on locality and national, not state, recourse.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Facility statute never substantively tested after standing dismissal; no later arrest documented; care-ban appellate status, licence/birth-certificate litigation, airport application, and current status of 2023 travel advisories unresolved.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Dismissal, preliminary and permanent injunctions, ACLU passport suit, commission investigation, and local ordinances show courts/institutions sometimes act for trans people.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Unresolved litigation means traveller cannot rely on eventual invalidation; current operative ban governs travel now.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar universal police-document exposure and ineffective-seeming remedy, but here courts dismissed the sole arrest, injunctions operate, and imprisonment beyond 60-day trespass maximum is not typical. Custody abuse if detained is more severe, offsetting some advantage, so rating sits above 0.35.

Closest: routine document/facility exposure, humiliation and care denial, uncommon prosecution, slow/partial remedies and uncertainty. Criminal trespass for bathrooms and documented custody sexual abuse push toward lower end of this tier.

Higher because there national equality law promptly reversed a brief hold with apology/compensation and no facility criminalisation. Here the facility ban itself is criminalised, state hate-crime law excludes gender identity, and custody harms are documented, so materially below 0.65.

parsed.synthesis: The traveller encounters one combined system: national binary documents and entry screening feed state facility enforcement, which can produce trespass arrest and birth-sex custody; national prison/immigration practices make any detention potentially severe. Protections are real but partial and contested — courts, injunctions, national hate-crime law and local ordinances — and do not pre-empt the operative facility, document or custody rules. Private-sector access and the narrow trespass trigger limit everyday risk, while minors face additional school, sport and care restrictions. Net effect is elevated risk, below the 0.45 anchor cluster's upper range.
